header.title: CSV / Spreadsheet Import
header.description: Import product data from a CSV file or Google Sheets

migration.title: Switching from Stripe, SumUp or Worldline?
migration.description: Bring your existing catalogue with you — nothing is written to your shop until you've reviewed every item.
migration.stripeLinked: Your Stripe account is linked — import your product catalogue in one click.
migration.stripeUnlinked: Link the Stripe account you already have: your checkout keeps working and your catalogue imports in one click.
migration.sumupDescription: In SumUp, export your item catalogue as CSV (Items → Export) and upload the file here.
migration.worldlineDescription: Upload a Worldline/SIX article or transaction export (CSV) — repeated sales collapse into one product each.

upload.title: Upload CSV File
upload.descriptionPrefix: Save your spreadsheet as CSV (UTF-8). Excel:

sheets.title: Google Sheets URL
sheets.columnsNote: The first sheet (tab) will be imported. Column names in the first row must match the template.

handwriting.title: Handwritten Inventory Photos
handwriting.description: Photograph pages from your diary or notebook — select as many as you like at once. AI will read each item's name, price, category, and quantity from every photo and build a combined list you can review and edit before importing.
handwriting.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC · max 10 MB each · multiple allowed

preview.uncheckNote: Uncheck any row you don't want to import — nothing is written until you click Import.
preview.errorNote: Rows with errors will be skipped. Edit the name, description, price, or category directly in the table above to fix them before importing.

done.updatedNote: Rows matching an existing product name were updated in place instead of duplicated.
done.visibleNote: Products are now visible in the shop. You can add photos via the admin panel.
